A team of three students makes *Quiz Dash*, a small online quiz game for
phones. Players need an account, their stars must be saved, there is a
weekly leaderboard, and each week a new question pack of **5 MB** is
downloaded. The team has **no servers** and little money.

## Task 1 · Services and kinds (2 marks)

a) Which cloud service fits each need: the account and the stars, the
leaderboard, the weekly question pack? (1 mark)

{{< answer-space lines=3 >}}

b) Which kind of cloud fits the team: public, private or hybrid? Why?
(1 mark)

{{< answer-space lines=2 >}}

## Task 2 · Models, players and risks (3 marks)

a) The team writes a small web page for the weekly results. It wants to
upload only its code, with no OS updates. Which model is this: IaaS, PaaS,
SaaS or BaaS? (1 mark)

{{< answer-space lines=1 >}}

b) On Friday evenings **ten times** more players play than in the morning.
Fixed servers or auto-scaling? Why? (1 mark)

{{< answer-space lines=2 >}}

c) Name two risks of the cloud for this team. (1 mark)
